description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kekula, Elapatha D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad Map No. 620503 (24/0530)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations regarding specific parcels of land. It involves the declaration of title determinations by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement under the Registration of Title Act, listing numerous land parcels with their ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
